title: Thousands Displaced as El Niño-Fueled Wildfire Threatens Nevada Homes
detail: A rapidly spreading wildfire in Nevada forced thousands of residents to evacuate as the blaze threatened homes and communities. Officials linked the conditions driving the fire — prolonged drought, record heat, and low humidity — to the intensifying 2026 El Niño cycle, which has elevated wildfire risk across the American West. The displacement adds to a growing list of extreme weather events attributed to the current Super El Niño episode.

media.caption: Thousands displaced as wildfire threatens Nevada homes amid El Niño-driven conditions
